name: servers_remove
description: Takes one MCP server's entry out of one agent's own config on one computer or workspace, in the scope servers lists it under, every other server and line of the file as it was, and, once no agent's config on this computer lists that server, frees the vault's values kept for it that no other server holds. Written as the login the computer was added with, into that agent's own file, which keeps its mode; a file that is a link out of the home, or out of the project for a project's file, is not written through, and a file the agent wrote meanwhile is left as it was. A napping workspace is not woken. The report there reads again at once.

name.description: the server's name, as servers lists it

agent.description: the catalog id of the agent whose config names it, as servers lists it

workspace.description: the workspace to read, by its name, or its id when two share a name; absent reads a computer

on.description: the computer to read, by the name computers lists; absent with no workspace is the computer the app runs on

scope.description: the scope servers lists it under: user, home or project; user without it

project.description: the project's server of that name: true from a workspace, or the project's name, as projects lists it, with on
